polity.en: Greek city-state (Roman ally from the 2nd c. BCE)
polity.zh: 希腊城邦（公元前2世纪起为罗马盟邦）

name.zh: 君士坦丁堡 / 伊斯坦布尔
伊斯坦布尔 / 君士坦丁堡

summary.en: Founded as the Greek colony of Byzantion, the city was refounded by Constantine I in 330 and served as capital of the Byzantine Empire, the Latin Empire and the Ottoman Empire. It lost capital status to Ankara in 1923; the name Istanbul became the only official form in 1930.
summary.zh: 该城始为希腊殖民城邦拜占庭，330年由君士坦丁一世重建，先后为拜占庭帝国、拉丁帝国和奥斯曼帝国的首都。1923年首都迁往安卡拉，1930年“伊斯坦布尔”成为唯一官方名称。

sources.title: Cassius Dio, Roman History LXXV (Severus' siege of Byzantium)
Philip Mansel, Constantinople: City of the World's Desire, 1453–1924 (1995)

note: Founding date (c. 660 BCE) is traditional; Byzantium's incorporation into a Roman province is dated to Vespasian (c. 73 CE). Constantinople remained in official and international use until the Postal Service Law of 28 March 1930 made Istanbul the only accepted form, hence the 1923–1930 transitional range.

polity.zh: 罗马帝国（不列颠尼亚行省）
盎格鲁—撒克逊诸王国（埃塞克斯、麦西亚）
威塞克斯 / 英格兰王国

summary.en: Founded by the Romans about 47 CE as Londinium, the city became the largest town of Roman Britain. After a post-Roman decline it revived as the Anglo-Saxon trading settlement of Lundenwic, was refortified by Alfred the Great in 886, and became the seat of English and later British government.
summary.zh: 罗马人约于公元47年建立伦蒂尼恩，使之成为罗马不列颠最大的城镇。罗马统治结束后一度衰落，后作为盎格鲁—撒克逊贸易聚落伦登维克复兴，886年由阿尔弗雷德大王重新设防，此后成为英格兰及后来英国的政府所在地。

note: Winchester rivalled London as a royal centre before 1066, so earlier periods are not marked as capital. The Roman founding date is archaeological (Wikidata: 47).

polity.zh: 罗马共和国 / 罗马帝国

polity.en: Western Roman Empire / Domain of Soissons
polity.zh: 西罗马帝国 / 苏瓦松王国
法兰克王国 / 西法兰克
法国（历届共和国、帝国及复辟王朝）

summary.en: The settlement of the Gallic Parisii, taken by Rome in 52 BCE, was known as Lutetia until the 4th century, when the name Parisius came into use. Clovis made it his seat in 508, and from the Capetian kings onward it became the capital of France.
summary.zh: 该地原为高卢部族帕里西人的聚落，公元前52年为罗马所占，直至4世纪一直称卢泰西亚，此后改用“巴黎西”之名。克洛维于508年以此为驻地，自卡佩王朝起巴黎成为法国首都。

sources.title: Julius Caesar, Commentarii de Bello Gallico VII.57–58

note: Versailles was the royal seat 1682–1789; the Merovingian and Carolingian courts were itinerant, so 486–987 is not marked as capital.

polity.zh: 俄罗斯沙皇国 / 俄罗斯帝国

polity.en: Russian Empire / Russian Republic / Soviet Russia
polity.zh: 俄罗斯帝国 / 俄罗斯共和国 / 苏维埃俄国

summary.en: Founded by Peter the Great on the Neva delta in 1703, the city replaced Moscow as Russia's capital from 1712 to 1918. It was renamed Petrograd in 1914 to sound less German, Leningrad in 1924 after Lenin's death, and Saint Petersburg again by referendum in 1991.
summary.zh: 1703年彼得大帝在涅瓦河三角洲建城，1712至1918年间取代莫斯科成为俄国首都。1914年为去德语色彩改名彼得格勒，1924年列宁逝世后改名列宁格勒，1991年经公投恢复圣彼得堡之名。

sources.title: Lindsey Hughes, Russia in the Age of Peter the Great (1998)

note: The capital move is usually dated 1712 (some say 1713); the Soviet government moved to Moscow in March 1918.

summary.en: Built in 1589 as the fortress of Tsaritsyn guarding the lower Volga, the city was renamed Stalingrad in 1925 and became the scene of the decisive battle of 1942–43. During de-Stalinisation it was renamed Volgograd in 1961.
summary.zh: 该城始建于1589年，为扼守伏尔加河下游的察里津要塞，1925年改名斯大林格勒，1942—1943年成为决定性战役的战场。1961年去斯大林化期间改名伏尔加格勒。

polity.zh: 波利安人（东斯拉夫部落）

polity.en: Rus' principality under the Golden Horde
polity.zh: 金帐汗国治下的罗斯公国
俄罗斯沙皇国（哥萨克酋长国）

polity.en: Contested: Ukrainian People's Republic / Soviet forces
polity.zh: 争夺中：乌克兰人民共和国 / 苏维埃军队
乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国（1922年起属苏联）
乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国（苏联）

summary.en: Capital of Kievan Rus' from the late 9th century, Kyiv was devastated by the Mongols in 1240 and later ruled by Lithuania, Poland–Lithuania and Russia. Capital of Soviet Ukraine from 1934, it became capital of independent Ukraine in 1991.
summary.zh: 基辅自9世纪末起为基辅罗斯首都，1240年遭蒙古人摧毁，此后先后由立陶宛、波兰—立陶宛和俄国统治。1934年起为苏维埃乌克兰首都，1991年成为独立的乌克兰首都。

sources.title: Russian Primary Chronicle (legend of Kyi; Oleg's capture of Kyiv, 882)
Serhii Plokhy, The Gates of Europe: A History of Ukraine (2015)

note: The founding date 482 (Wikidata) is a traditional figure set for the city's 1500th anniversary in 1982; 882 for Oleg follows the Primary Chronicle. Kharkiv was capital of Soviet Ukraine until 1934.

polity.zh: 罗马帝国（诺里库姆 / 潘诺尼亚）

polity.en: Successive rulers: Lombards, Avars, Carolingian March
polity.zh: 相继统治者：伦巴第人、阿瓦尔人、加洛林边区
奥地利边区（神圣罗马帝国）
奥地利公国（巴本贝格家族）
哈布斯堡奥地利（神圣罗马帝国）

summary.en: The Roman legionary fortress of Vindobona on the Danube frontier grew into medieval Wien, seat of the Babenberg dukes from 1155 and of the Habsburgs from 1278. It was the capital of the Habsburg monarchy and Austria-Hungary, and of the Austrian republic except during the 1938–45 annexation.
summary.zh: 多瑙河边疆上的罗马军团要塞文多博纳发展为中世纪的维也纳，1155年起为巴本贝格公爵驻地，1278年起为哈布斯堡家族驻地。它是哈布斯堡君主国和奥匈帝国的首都，除1938—1945年被吞并期间外，也一直是奥地利共和国首都。

sources.title: Pieter M. Judson, The Habsburg Empire: A New History (2016)

note: The legionary fortress dates from c. 97 CE; the Roman period here starts with the annexation of Noricum (15 BCE). The name Wenia is first recorded in 881; 488 marks the Roman evacuation of Noricum.

polity.zh: 罗马共和国 / 罗马帝国
罗马帝国（下日耳曼尼亚行省首府）

polity.en: Franks: Ripuarian kingdom, Francia, Lotharingia, East Francia
polity.zh: 法兰克人：里普利安王国、法兰克王国、洛林、东法兰克

polity.en: Holy Roman Empire (Electorate / Free Imperial City)
polity.zh: 神圣罗马帝国（选侯国 / 帝国自由城市）
法兰西共和国 / 法兰西第一帝国

summary.en: Founded as the Oppidum Ubiorum, a town of the Ubii resettled by Rome, it received colonial status in 50 CE, named after Agrippina, wife of Emperor Claudius. Taken by the Franks in the 5th century, it became a great archbishopric and trading city of the Holy Roman Empire, then passed to France and Prussia.
summary.zh: 该城始为罗马安置的乌比人城镇，公元50年获殖民地地位，并以克劳狄乌斯皇帝之妻阿格里皮娜命名。5世纪为法兰克人所占，后成为神圣罗马帝国重要的大主教驻地和商业城市，近代先后归属法国和普鲁士。

sources.title: Tacitus, Annals XII.27 (foundation of the colonia)

note: The Frankish takeover is dated c. 459; 38 BCE for the Ubii resettlement is traditional (dates between 38 and 19 BCE are proposed).

polity.zh: 罗马帝国（下不列颠尼亚行省首府）
德伊勒 / 诺森布里亚王国

summary.en: Founded as the legionary fortress of Eboracum in 71 CE, York was where Constantine the Great was proclaimed emperor in 306. It became Anglian Eoforwic, the Viking capital Jórvík after 866, and an archbishopric and leading city of medieval northern England.
summary.zh: 约克始建于公元71年，为罗马军团要塞埃博拉库姆，306年君士坦丁大帝在此被拥立为帝。此后它成为盎格鲁人的埃奥福维克，866年后为维京人的都城约维克，中世纪时是英格兰北部的大主教驻地和首要城市。

争夺中：拜占庭、匈牙利、保加利亚

polity.zh: 斯雷姆王国（塞尔维亚） / 匈牙利王国
革命塞尔维亚（第一次塞尔维亚起义）

polity.en: Ottoman Empire (autonomous Principality of Serbia from 1815–30, seat at Kragujevac)
polity.zh: 奥斯曼帝国（1815—1830年起塞尔维亚公国自治，驻地克拉古耶瓦茨）

polity.en: Principality of Serbia (Ottoman vassal until 1878) / Kingdom of Serbia (from 1882)
polity.zh: 塞尔维亚公国（1878年前为奥斯曼藩属）/ 塞尔维亚王国（1882年起）
南斯拉夫联盟共和国 / 塞尔维亚和黑山

summary.en: The Celtic and Roman Singidunum at the Sava–Danube confluence was fought over for centuries; its Slavic name, 'white city', first appears in 878. A Serbian capital in 1403–27, it was Hungarian and then Ottoman, became the capital of Serbia again in the 19th century and later of Yugoslavia.
summary.zh: 位于萨瓦河与多瑙河交汇处的辛吉杜努姆原为凯尔特和罗马城镇，数百年间屡遭争夺；其斯拉夫语名称意为“白城”，最早见于878年。1403至1427年为塞尔维亚首都，后归匈牙利和奥斯曼帝国，19世纪重新成为塞尔维亚首都，后又为南斯拉夫首都。

sources.title: Letter of Pope John VIII to Boris I of Bulgaria (878), first mention of Beligrad

note: Many short-lived changes of rule (especially 6th–13th c.) are simplified. Belgrade was the seat of the rebel Governing Council in 1807–13 and Serbia’s princely capital from 1841, though an Ottoman garrison held the fortress until 1867. Wartime occupations (Austro-Hungarian 1915–18, German 1941–44) are not shown separately.

polity.en: State of the Teutonic Order (seat of the Grand Master from 1457)
polity.zh: 条顿骑士团国（1457年起为大团长驻地）
苏联（俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国）

summary.en: Founded by the Teutonic Knights in 1255 and named in honour of King Ottokar II of Bohemia, Königsberg became the capital of ducal Prussia and the coronation city of Prussian kings; Immanuel Kant lived there. Taken by the Red Army in 1945, it was annexed by the USSR and renamed Kaliningrad in 1946.
summary.zh: 柯尼斯堡由条顿骑士团于1255年建立，以纪念波希米亚国王奥托卡二世而得名，后成为普鲁士公国首都和普鲁士国王的加冕之城，哲学家康德即居于此。1945年被红军攻占，随后并入苏联，1946年改名加里宁格勒。

sources.title: Christopher Clark, Iron Kingdom: The Rise and Downfall of Prussia (2006)

note: Renamed on 4 July 1946. The Duchy of Prussia was a Polish fief until 1657.

polity.zh: 波兰 / 东波美拉尼亚公国

polity.en: Kingdom of Poland (Royal Prussia); Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth from 1569
polity.zh: 波兰王国（王室普鲁士）；1569年起属波兰—立陶宛联邦
但泽自由市（拿破仑时期）

polity.en: Free City of Danzig (League of Nations)

summary.en: First recorded in 997 as urbs Gyddanyzc in the Life of St Adalbert, the port was seized by the Teutonic Knights in 1308 and flourished as a Hanseatic city under the Polish crown after 1454. Prussian from 1793, a Free City between the world wars, it became Polish in 1945.
summary.zh: 该港最早于997年以“格但斯克城”之名见于《圣阿达尔贝特传》，1308年被条顿骑士团占领，1454年后在波兰王权下作为汉萨同盟城市而繁荣。1793年归普鲁士，两次世界大战之间为自由市，1945年归属波兰。

polity.en: Roman Republic / Roman Empire (capital of Macedonia)
polity.zh: 罗马共和国 / 罗马帝国（马其顿行省首府）
帖撒罗尼迦帝国（伊庇鲁斯系）
拜占庭帝国（尼西亚，后为君士坦丁堡）

summary.en: Founded by King Cassander of Macedon in 315 BCE and named after his wife, a half-sister of Alexander the Great, the city was the second city of the Byzantine Empire. Ottoman Selanik from 1430, it had a Sephardic Jewish majority for centuries before passing to Greece in 1912.
summary.zh: 该城由马其顿国王卡山德于公元前315年建立，以其妻（亚历山大大帝的同父异母姐妹）命名，曾是拜占庭帝国第二大城市。1430年起为奥斯曼帝国的萨洛尼卡，数百年间以塞法迪犹太人为多数居民，1912年归属希腊。

sources.title: Mark Mazower, Salonica, City of Ghosts: Christians, Muslims and Jews, 1430–1950 (2004)

note: The first Ottoman rule (surrender in April 1387, returned to Byzantium by treaty with Süleyman Çelebi in 1403) is shown; the Norman sack of 1185 and the German occupation of 1941–44 are not shown separately.

polity.zh: 罗马王政 / 罗马共和国
奥多亚克王国 / 东哥特王国

summary.en: By tradition founded in 753 BCE, Rome was the capital of the Roman Republic and Empire, though emperors increasingly resided elsewhere after the 3rd century. After Gothic and Byzantine rule it became the capital of the Papal States, and in 1871 the capital of united Italy.
summary.zh: 罗马相传建于公元前753年，是罗马共和国和罗马帝国的首都，但3世纪后皇帝日益常驻他处。经历哥特人和拜占庭统治后，它成为教皇国的首都，1871年成为统一后意大利的首都。

sources.title: Livy, Ab Urbe Condita, Book I

note: 753 BCE is the traditional (Varronian) founding date. Rome was captured by the Kingdom of Italy in September 1870 and proclaimed capital in 1871; brief French-era interruptions (1798–99, 1809–14) are not shown.

polity.zh: 弗拉基米尔—苏兹达尔公国
俄罗斯沙皇国 / 俄罗斯帝国

summary.en: First mentioned in a chronicle under 1147, Moscow rose as the seat of a grand principality that gathered the Russian lands, and as the capital of the tsars. Peter the Great moved the capital to Saint Petersburg in 1712; the Bolsheviks restored Moscow as capital in 1918.
summary.zh: 莫斯科最早见于编年史1147年条目，后作为统一罗斯诸地的大公国驻地和沙皇首都而兴起。1712年彼得大帝迁都圣彼得堡，1918年布尔什维克政权重新定都莫斯科。

polity.en: Roman Republic and Empire (capital of Hispania Baetica); then autonomous Hispano-Roman city
polity.zh: 罗马共和国与罗马帝国（贝提卡行省首府）；后为自治的西班牙—罗马城市
倭马亚哈里发国（安达卢斯省）

polity.en: Taifa of Córdoba, Abbadid Seville (1070–91), then Almoravids and Almohads
polity.zh: 科尔多瓦泰法王国、塞维利亚阿巴德王朝（1070—1091年），后归穆拉比特与穆瓦希德王朝

summary.en: Founded as the Roman colony of Corduba, the city became Qurṭuba, capital of Umayyad al-Andalus, and under the caliphs of the tenth century was one of the largest and most learned cities in Europe. Ferdinand III of Castile took it in 1236.
summary.zh: 该城始建为罗马殖民地科尔杜巴，后称古尔图巴，成为安达卢斯倭马亚政权的都城；10世纪哈里发时代，它是欧洲规模最大、学术最盛的城市之一。1236年卡斯蒂利亚国王费尔南多三世攻取此城。

story.en:
Corduba was already a provincial capital in Roman times and the birthplace of the philosopher Seneca. Its great age began in 756, when Abd al-Rahman I, a survivor of the Abbasid massacre of his family in Syria, made it the seat of an independent Umayyad emirate. He began the Great Mosque in 785, and his successors kept enlarging it for two centuries.

In 929 Abd al-Rahman III proclaimed himself caliph. Qurṭuba then had paved and lit streets, public baths, a palace-city at Madinat al-Zahra outside the walls, and a royal library that later writers credited with hundreds of thousands of volumes (an often-repeated figure that historians treat with caution). Jewish, Christian and Muslim scholars worked there, and the city later produced Averroes and Maimonides.

Civil war after 1009 broke the caliphate into taifa kingdoms, and Córdoba never recovered its primacy. When Ferdinand III of Castile entered it on 29 June 1236, the mosque was consecrated as a cathedral; in the sixteenth century a Renaissance nave was built into the middle of its forest of arches.
story.zh:
罗马时代的科尔杜巴已是行省首府，也是哲学家塞涅卡的故乡。它的鼎盛始于756年：在叙利亚逃过阿拔斯王朝屠杀的倭马亚王子阿卜杜·拉赫曼一世以此为独立埃米尔国的都城，785年开始兴建大清真寺，其后继者在两百年间不断扩建。

929年，阿卜杜·拉赫曼三世自立为哈里发。此时的古尔图巴街道铺石、夜间有灯，公共浴室林立，城外建有宫城扎赫拉城，王室图书馆据后世记载藏书数十万卷（这一常被引用的数字，史家多持保留态度）。犹太、基督教与穆斯林学者在此共事，后来这里又走出了阿威罗伊与迈蒙尼德。

1009年后的内战使哈里发国分裂为诸泰法小国，科尔多瓦再未恢复往日的首要地位。1236年6月29日卡斯蒂利亚国王费尔南多三世入城，大清真寺被祝圣为主教座堂；16世纪，人们又在其拱柱林中央修建了一座文艺复兴式的中殿。

sources.title: Hugh Kennedy, Muslim Spain and Portugal: A Political History of al-Andalus (1996)
UNESCO World Heritage: Historic Centre of Cordoba

note: Roman founding by M. Claudius Marcellus is dated 169 or 152 BCE; 152 is used. Córdoba was outside Visigothic control until Liuvigild took it in 572.

name.zh: 奥利西波（费利奇塔斯·尤利娅）

polity.zh: 罗马共和国与罗马帝国（卢西塔尼亚行省）

name.zh: 奥利西波 / 乌利克斯博纳

polity.en: Alans, Suebi and the Visigothic Kingdom
polity.zh: 阿兰人、苏维汇人与西哥特王国
安达卢斯（倭马亚王朝、巴达霍斯泰法、穆拉比特王朝）

summary.en: Roman Olisipo became the Moorish al-Ushbūna and was taken in 1147 by Afonso I with the help of crusaders bound for the Holy Land. Capital of Portugal from about 1255, it was the base of the overseas voyages, was rebuilt after the earthquake of 1755, and saw the Carnation Revolution of 1974.
summary.zh: 罗马时代的奥利西波后为摩尔人的乌什布纳，1147年阿方索一世在前往圣地的十字军协助下攻占此城。约1255年起为葡萄牙首都，是大航海的出发地，1755年大地震后重建，1974年发生康乃馨革命。

story.en:
In June 1147 a fleet of English, Flemish and Rhineland crusaders sailing for the Second Crusade put in at Porto. The young king Afonso Henriques persuaded them to help him besiege the Moorish city of al-Ushbūna instead, promising them its plunder. An eyewitness letter, De expugnatione Lyxbonensi, describes siege towers, mining and hunger before the garrison surrendered on 24 October.

Lisbon replaced Coimbra as the usual royal seat in the thirteenth century. Under Manuel I it became the hub of the sea route to India: the riverside Ribeira palace overlooked the docks, and the Belém tower and Jerónimos monastery were paid for by the spice trade. From 1580 to 1640 it was ruled by the Spanish Habsburg kings in the Iberian Union.

On 1 November 1755 an earthquake, tsunami and fire destroyed most of the city. The Marquis of Pombal rebuilt the Baixa on a grid with some of the first earthquake-resistant timber frames, the gaiola.
story.zh:
1147年6月，一支由英格兰、佛兰德与莱茵兰十字军组成、前往参加第二次十字军东征的舰队停靠波尔图。年轻的国王阿方索·恩里克斯说服他们转而协助围攻摩尔人的城市乌什布纳，并许以城中财物。一封目击者书信《攻克里斯本记》描述了攻城塔、地道与饥馑，守军最终于10月24日投降。

13世纪，里斯本取代科英布拉成为王室常驻之地。曼努埃尔一世时，它成为通往印度海路的枢纽：河畔的里贝拉宫俯瞰码头，贝伦塔和热罗尼莫斯修道院都由香料贸易出资兴建。1580年至1640年，它在伊比利亚联合时期由西班牙哈布斯堡国王统治。

1755年11月1日，地震、海啸和大火摧毁了城市的大部分。庞巴尔侯爵以棋盘格局重建下城，并采用了最早的抗震木构架之一“鸟笼”结构。

sources.title: De expugnatione Lyxbonensi, ed. C. W. David (1936)
A. H. de Oliveira Marques, History of Portugal (1972)

note: Roman control dates from Decimus Junius Brutus's campaign of 138 BCE. The Moorish conquest of the city is dated 714–716; 714 is used. Coimbra was the main royal seat until the mid-13th century, so the capital flag starts c. 1255.

polity.zh: 挪威王国（1397年起属卡尔马联盟）

polity.en: Kingdom of Norway (in union with Sweden)
Kingdom of Norway (union with Sweden until 1905)
polity.zh: 挪威王国（1905年前与瑞典联合）

summary.en: Medieval Oslo, traditionally founded by Harald Hardrada about 1048, burned in 1624; Christian IV of Denmark-Norway rebuilt it beside Akershus fortress and named it Christiania. It became the capital of a self-governing Norway in 1814, was spelled Kristiania from 1877, and took back the name Oslo on 1 January 1925.
summary.zh: 中世纪的奥斯陆相传由哈拉尔·哈德拉达约于1048年建立，1624年毁于大火；丹麦—挪威国王克里斯蒂安四世在阿克斯胡斯要塞旁重建新城，命名为克里斯蒂安尼亚。1814年它成为自治的挪威的首都，1877年起拼作Kristiania，1925年1月1日恢复奥斯陆旧名。

story.en:
According to Snorri Sturluson's sagas, King Harald Hardrada founded a market town at the head of the Oslofjord around 1048. King Haakon V built Akershus fortress about 1299 and made Oslo his main residence, but the medieval town of wooden houses burned again and again.

After a three-day fire in August 1624, Christian IV, king of Denmark-Norway, decided not to rebuild on the old site. He laid out a new grid town under the walls of Akershus, required stone or half-timbered buildings, and named it Christiania after himself. When Norway left Danish rule in 1814 and adopted the Eidsvoll constitution, Christiania became the capital, even though the country entered a union with Sweden that year.

Norwegian spelling reforms produced Kristiania in 1877. In the 1920s, with Norway fully independent since 1905, the Storting voted to restore the medieval name, and the city became Oslo again on 1 January 1925; the old town east of the river is still called Gamlebyen.
story.zh:
据斯诺里·斯蒂德吕松的萨迦记载，国王哈拉尔·哈德拉达约在1048年于奥斯陆峡湾顶端建立集镇。约1299年，国王哈康五世修建阿克斯胡斯要塞，并以奥斯陆为主要驻地，但这座木屋林立的中世纪城镇屡遭火灾。

1624年8月一场延烧三天的大火之后，丹麦—挪威国王克里斯蒂安四世决定不在原址重建，而是在阿克斯胡斯城墙下规划棋盘式新城，规定建筑须用石材或半木结构，并以自己的名字命名为克里斯蒂安尼亚。1814年挪威脱离丹麦、通过埃兹沃尔宪法，克里斯蒂安尼亚成为首都，尽管同年挪威又与瑞典结成联盟。

1877年的挪威正字法改革使城名拼作Kristiania。1905年挪威完全独立后，议会于1920年代投票恢复中世纪旧名，1925年1月1日该城重新称为奥斯陆；河东的老城区至今仍叫“旧城”（Gamlebyen）。

sources.title: Snorri Sturluson, Heimskringla: Haralds saga harðráða
Oslo byleksikon (Oslo city encyclopedia), entries "Christiania" and "Navnet Oslo"

note: The c. 1048 founding is traditional (saga-based; archaeology suggests a settlement around 1000). "Kristiania" was used by the state from 1877 and by the city from 1897.

polity.zh: 德国（德意志帝国、魏玛共和国、纳粹德国）

polity.zh: 苏联占领区，后为德意志民主共和国

summary.en: A twelfth-century market town that grew into the "Saxon Manchester" of textile mills and machine works, Chemnitz was largely destroyed by bombing in March 1945. The East German state renamed it Karl-Marx-Stadt in 1953; after a referendum the old name returned on 1 June 1990.
summary.zh: 开姆尼茨是12世纪的集镇，后发展为纺织厂与机器制造业云集的“萨克森的曼彻斯特”，1945年3月大部分毁于轰炸。1953年东德政府将其改名为卡尔-马克思城；经公民投票，1990年6月1日恢复旧名。

story.en:
Chemnitz grew around a Benedictine abbey founded by Emperor Lothair III in 1136; in 1143 King Conrad III granted it market rights. In the nineteenth century its cotton mills, locomotive works and machine-tool factories earned it the nickname "Saxon Manchester", and by 1930 it had over 350,000 people.

Allied bombing on 5 March 1945 destroyed most of the old centre. In 1953, the year Karl Marx would have turned 135 and two months after Stalin's death, the government of the German Democratic Republic renamed the rebuilt city Karl-Marx-Stadt, though Marx had no connection to it. A forty-ton bronze head of Marx by the Soviet sculptor Lev Kerbel was unveiled in 1971 in front of the new party and state offices; locals call it "Nischel", Saxon dialect for head.

In a vote held on 23 April 1990, after the fall of the Berlin Wall, about three quarters of the residents who took part chose the old name, which returned on 1 June 1990. The Marx head still stands; Chemnitz was named a European Capital of Culture for 2025.
story.zh:
开姆尼茨围绕皇帝洛塔尔三世于1136年建立的本笃会修道院发展起来，1143年国王康拉德三世授予此地集市权。19世纪，这里的棉纺厂、机车厂和机床厂使其获得“萨克森的曼彻斯特”之称，到1930年人口已超过35万。

1945年3月5日的盟军轰炸摧毁了老城的大部分。1953年，正值马克思诞辰135周年、斯大林去世两个月之后，德意志民主共和国政府把重建中的城市改名为卡尔-马克思城，尽管马克思与此地毫无渊源。1971年，苏联雕塑家列夫·克尔贝尔创作的约40吨重的马克思青铜头像在新建的党政大楼前揭幕，当地人用萨克森方言称之为“Nischel”（脑袋）。

柏林墙倒塌后，1990年4月23日举行的投票中约四分之三的参与者选择恢复旧名，城市于1990年6月1日重新称为开姆尼茨。马克思头像至今仍矗立原地；开姆尼茨还当选为2025年欧洲文化之都。

sources.title: Mary Fulbrook, The People's State: East German Society from Hitler to Honecker (2005)

summary.en: A Roman spa named after the Celtic god Grannus, Aachen became the favourite residence of Charlemagne, who built the palace chapel where he was buried in 814. German kings were crowned there from 936 to 1531; under French rule (1794–1815) it was Aix-la-Chapelle.
summary.zh: 亚琛原为以凯尔特神祇格兰努斯命名的罗马温泉地，后成为查理曼最喜爱的驻地，他在此修建宫廷礼拜堂，814年安葬于此。936年至1531年间德意志国王在此加冕；法国统治时期（1794—1815年）称艾克斯拉沙佩勒。

sources.title: Einhard, Vita Karoli Magni, ch. 22 and 26

note: Roman baths date from the 1st century CE; the name Aquae Granni is attested later. Aachen was occupied by France in 1794 and formally annexed in 1801 (Treaty of Lunéville). The "capital" flag marks Charlemagne's main residence, as Francia had no fixed capital.

summary.en: Greek settlers from Phocaea founded Massalia about 600 BCE; it backed Pompey and was taken by Caesar in 49 BCE. Under Provençal counts it was a crusader port, passed to the French crown with Provence in 1481, and gave its name to the anthem sung by its volunteers in 1792.
summary.zh: 约公元前600年，来自福西亚的希腊移民建立马萨利亚；它支持庞培，公元前49年被恺撒攻占。在普罗旺斯伯爵统治下它是十字军港口，1481年随普罗旺斯归入法国王室，1792年当地志愿军所唱的战歌以其城名命名为《马赛曲》。

sources.title: Julius Caesar, De bello civili II.1–22 (siege of Massilia)

note: The founding date (c. 600 BCE) is traditional and archaeologically supported in range only. Provence was bequeathed to Louis XI in 1481 and united to the French crown in 1486.

summary.en: Celtic Mediolanum was taken by Rome in 222 BCE and from 286 was a residence of western emperors; Constantine and Licinius agreed the Edict of Milan there in 313. Lombard, imperial, ducal, Spanish, Austrian and Napoleonic Milan joined Italy in 1859.
summary.zh: 凯尔特人的梅迪奥拉努姆于公元前222年被罗马攻取，286年起为西部皇帝驻地；313年君士坦丁与李锡尼在此达成《米兰敕令》。此后米兰历经伦巴第、帝国、公爵、西班牙、奥地利与拿破仑时代，1859年并入意大利。

sources.title: Evelyn S. Welch, Art and Authority in Renaissance Milan (1995)

note: Western emperors resided at Milan from Maximian (286) until Honorius moved to Ravenna in 402. The Visconti were made dukes in 1395; the Sforza line ended in 1535.

polity.zh: 安达卢斯（倭马亚总督、科尔多瓦埃米尔国与哈里发国）

polity.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚王冠（流动宫廷的主要驻地）

summary.en: Roman Toletum became the capital of the Visigothic kingdom and the seat of its church councils, then Moorish Ṭulayṭula. Alfonso VI took it in 1085, and its translators turned Arabic science and philosophy into Latin; Philip II's move of the court to Madrid in 1561 ended its political primacy.
summary.zh: 罗马时代的托莱图姆后成为西哥特王国首都和宗教会议所在地，继而为摩尔人的图莱图拉。1085年阿方索六世攻取此城，这里的翻译家把阿拉伯科学与哲学译成拉丁文；1561年腓力二世迁都马德里，托莱多的政治首要地位就此终结。

story.en:
Toletum, on a granite hill ringed by the River Tagus, was taken by the Roman praetor Marcus Fulvius Nobilior in 193 BCE. King Athanagild made it the Visigothic capital in the 560s, and eighteen church councils met there between 400 and 702, among them the Third Council of 589, where King Reccared renounced Arian Christianity for Catholicism.

After 711 the city, as Ṭulayṭula, became a frontier stronghold that often defied Córdoba, and from 1035 the capital of its own taifa kingdom. When Alfonso VI of León-Castile entered it on 25 May 1085, he guaranteed its Muslim and Jewish inhabitants their property and worship, a promise later only partly kept.

Over the next two centuries Toledo was Europe's great translation centre. Scholars such as Gerard of Cremona rendered Ptolemy, Avicenna and al-Khwarizmi into Latin, often working with Mozarab and Jewish intermediaries, and Alfonso X sponsored translations into Castilian. The court's move to Madrid in 1561 froze the city in its old shape, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
story.zh:
托莱图姆坐落于塔霍河环绕的花岗岩山丘上，公元前193年被罗马裁判官马库斯·弗尔维乌斯·诺比利奥尔攻取。560年代西哥特国王阿塔纳吉尔德以此为都，400年至702年间这里召开过18次宗教会议，其中589年第三次会议上国王雷卡雷德放弃阿里乌派，皈依天主教。

711年后，这座城市称为图莱图拉，是一座常与科尔多瓦对抗的边境重镇，1035年起成为独立泰法王国的首都。1085年5月25日莱昂—卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索六世入城，承诺保障穆斯林与犹太居民的财产和信仰，但这一承诺后来只得到部分履行。

此后两百年间，托莱多是欧洲最重要的翻译中心。克雷莫纳的杰拉德等学者常借助莫扎拉布人和犹太中间人，把托勒密、伊本·西那和花拉子米的著作译成拉丁文；阿方索十世还资助译成卡斯蒂利亚语。1561年宫廷迁往马德里，城市由此保留了旧貌，现为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

sources.title: Bernard F. Reilly, The Kingdom of León-Castilla under King Alfonso VI (1988)
UNESCO World Heritage: Historic City of Toledo

note: The start of Visigothic rule (c. 472) and the date Toledo became the royal seat (Athanagild, c. 567) are approximate.

summary.en: Roman Hispalis became Ishbīliya, capital of the Abbadid taifa and the Almohads' main city in Spain, whose minaret survives as the Giralda. Castile took it in 1248; from 1503 it held the royal monopoly on trade with the Americas through the Casa de Contratación.
summary.zh: 罗马时代的希斯帕利斯后称伊什比利亚，为阿巴德泰法王国的首都和穆瓦希德王朝在西班牙的主要城市，其宣礼塔留存至今，即吉拉尔达塔。1248年卡斯蒂利亚攻取此城；1503年起，它通过贸易署垄断王室与美洲的贸易。

sources.title: Ruth Pike, Aristocrats and Traders: Sevillian Society in the Sixteenth Century (1972)
UNESCO World Heritage: Cathedral, Alcázar and Archivo de Indias in Seville

note: Roman control follows the battle of Ilipa (206 BCE). Seville was the Almohads' capital in al-Andalus (co-capital with Marrakesh), not of the whole caliphate, so that span is not flagged as capital.

summary.en: Vikings set up a longphort by the "black pool" (Dubh Linn) in 841; the Norse town of Dyflin was taken by Anglo-Norman invaders in 1170–71 and became the seat of English rule in Ireland. It was the capital of the Kingdom of Ireland, the second city of the UK after 1801 and capital of the Irish state from 1922.
summary.zh: 841年维京人在“黑潭”（Dubh Linn）旁建立船营；1170—1171年，诺斯人的迪夫林被盎格鲁—诺曼入侵者攻占，成为英格兰统治爱尔兰的中心。它曾是爱尔兰王国的首都，1801年后是联合王国的第二大城，1922年起为爱尔兰国家的首都。

sources.title: Howard B. Clarke (ed.), Medieval Dublin: The Making of a Metropolis (1990)

note: An earlier Irish settlement, Áth Cliath ("ford of hurdles"), lay nearby; its name survives in the modern Irish form. The Norse kingdom was interrupted (902–917), which is not split here.

summary.en: Founded under Augustus as Augusta Treverorum, Trier was the residence of western emperors from the Tetrarchy, and Constantine built its great basilica; the Porta Nigra still stands. Its archbishops were prince-electors of the Holy Roman Empire. Karl Marx was born there in 1818.
summary.zh: 特里尔建于奥古斯都时代，名为奥古斯塔·特雷维罗鲁姆，四帝共治起为西部皇帝驻地，君士坦丁在此修建大会堂，黑门至今犹存。其大主教是神圣罗马帝国选帝侯。1818年卡尔·马克思生于此地。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage: Roman Monuments, Cathedral of St Peter and Church of Our Lady in Trier
Edith Mary Wightman, Roman Trier and the Treveri (1970)

note: The founding year (16 BCE) is traditional; the city celebrated its 2,000th anniversary in 1984. The prefecture of the Gauls moved to Arles around 395–407; Frankish control was established in the later 5th century.

summary.en: Lugdunum was founded in 43 BCE by Lucius Munatius Plancus and became the chief city of Roman Gaul, birthplace of the emperor Claudius. After Burgundian and Frankish rule it lay in the Empire until annexed to France in 1312; its fairs and silk weaving made it France's second city.
summary.zh: 卢格杜努姆由卢基乌斯·穆纳提乌斯·普兰库斯于公元前43年建立，是罗马高卢的首要城市，也是克劳狄乌斯皇帝的出生地。历经勃艮第与法兰克统治后，它长期隶属神圣罗马帝国，1312年并入法国；集市与丝织业使其成为法国第二大城。

sources.title: Cassius Dio, Roman History XLVI.50 (foundation by Plancus)
UNESCO World Heritage: Historic Site of Lyons
